$Comment: LOA: ranged creep attack - shoots arrows using the Skeleton Scout bow shot

AttackDistance.Description: The distance at which an NPC will execute attacks

CombatRelativeTurnSpeed.Description: Modifier that decides turn speed difference in combat

AimHitProbability.Description: LOA: chance of a shot going straight at the target (engine default 0.33)

AimSpread.Description: LOA: random aim error when a shot is not straight, 0-5 (engine default 1)
